plan.title: eRFX RFQ Stage Optional Terms Acceptance

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Compose the required Technical plus RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the RFQ item to quote.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute schedule.
Add one QA vendor to the event without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session.
Open the event's Technical stage as the vendor.
Verify the RFQ-only clause is not requested on the Technical stage.
Verify the second RFQ-only clause is not requested on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the clauses should be presented.
Verify the first clause is shown to the vendor on the RFQ stage.
Verify the second clause is shown to the vendor on the RFQ stage.
Accept the first optional clause.
Accept the second optional clause.
Submit the vendor's quote of 100 for the RFQ line.
Verify the vendor submission succeeded after accepting both clauses.
Return to the buyer's project page.
Verify the buyer sees the vendor's RFQ response.
Verify the first RFQ clause remains visible in the buyer-side event context.
Verify the second RFQ clause remains visible in the buyer-side event context.
